what: Toro makes turf equipment: the mowers that cut golf courses and sports fields, professional landscaping equipment, irrigation systems, and snow blowers and mowers for homeowners.
customers: Golf courses, groundskeepers, landscaping contractors and homeowners, through dealers and retailers.
money: golf course and grounds equipment, irrigation and landscape contractor machines
lawn mowers, snow blowers and yard tools sold through retailers
moat: The default brand on golf courses and sports fields, where equipment is bought by professionals who value durability and service over price and who stay with a brand for decades.
risks: Landscape contractor demand fell sharply after the pandemic boom and has not recovered
Revenue has been flat around $4.5B for three years
Weather decides snow blower and irrigation sales each year
opportunities: $712M of free cash flow at about 14 times cash flow
Analysts see about 8% upside, and the dividend has been raised for about fifteen years
Golf course construction and renovation activity has been at its highest in years
watch: Professional segment orders and the recovery in landscape contractor demand.
